name_vi: Túi cầm tay vỏ sò bản lề
description_en: A flattened scalloped shell-shaped cane clutch with two hinged halves and textile lining. Canonical front: radiating scallop ribs and a small plain clasp. Side view: the shallow bulging shell profile and hinge seam. Rear view: a second scalloped woven shell with the concealed hinge. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A flattened scalloped shell-shaped cane clutch with two hinged halves and textile lining. Canonical front: radiating scallop ribs and a small plain clasp. Side view: the shallow bulging shell profile and hinge seam. Rear view: a second scalloped woven shell with the concealed hinge. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Zen: calm minimal ornament and simple proportions. Relative size medium within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
